name: comp-320
title: Delete Confirm Dialog
blurb: Requires typing the project name to confirm a destructive action.
description: A shadcn Dialog with a warning icon and text input that enables the delete button only after the user types the exact project name to confirm.
use_when: Protecting against accidental deletion of projects, accounts, or other irreversible resources.
avoid_when: Low-stakes or easily reversible actions — the confirmation friction is only justified for destructive operations.
a11y: Inherits dialog accessibility from shadcn; input is properly labeled; keyboard navigation and focus management fully supported.
